utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Please call the case, Madam Registrar.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. This is case number IT-05-88-A, the Prosecutor versus Popovic et al.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: And may I have the appearances for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCHNEIDER
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. Todd Schneider for the Prosecution, along with Ms. Ingrid Elliott and Mr. Colin Nawrot.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. And for the Defence for Mr. Popovic.

utterances.speaker: MS. TAPUSKOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honour. On behalf of Mr. Popovic, Ms. Mira Tapuskovic, co-counsel.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Just a minute. I noticed that he's not here but a waiver has been submitted.

utterances.speaker: MS. TAPUSKOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, Your Honour. The procedure of receiving his waiver is under way so that we can proceed without him. I don't know whether the Registrar has received it. I see that they are nodding. He couldn't attend for personal reasons because of something that happened in his family and that's why he waived his right to appear today in the courtroom.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: And I take it you are fully briefed as to any issues that he might wish to raise today.

utterances.speaker: MS. TAPUSKOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, certainly, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. For Mr. Beara.

utterances.speaker: MR. OSTOJIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Mr. President. John Ostojic on behalf of Ljubisa Beara. Mr. Beara also is not present. We are in the process of obtaining his waiver. I have spoken to him twice yesterday and earlier in the week and he apologises for not being here, and his waiver should be shortly forthcoming.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: And I take it also that you are fully briefed as to any issues that he might have wanted to raise.

utterances.speaker: MR. OSTOJIC
utterances.text: I am, Your Honour, yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Nikolic.

utterances.speaker: MS. NIKOLIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honour. On behalf of Drago Nikolic, my name is Jelena Nikolic. Mr. Stephane Bourgon is here and Marlene Yahya, who is our legal assistant.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. And for Mr. Miletic?

utterances.speaker: MS. FAUVEAU
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour, Natacha Fauveau-Ivanovic for Mr. Radivoje Miletic, together with Mr. Petrusic, co-counsel.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Mr. Pandurevic.

utterances.speaker: MR. HAYNES
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. Peter Haynes for Pandurevic, together with Ms. Helena Tosic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Mr. Gvero.

utterances.speaker: MR. KRGOVIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Dragan Krgovic appearing for General Gvero.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Well, I'll start with a summary of the motions before the Chamber. First, the Chamber is currently seized of a total of four motions under Rule 115. These consist of two motions filed by Mr. Popovic, his third and fourth motions pursuant to Rule 115, filed on the 15th of August, 2011, and the 19th of September, 2011, respectively; and two motions filed by Mr. Miletic, his first and second motions, pursuant to Rule 115, filed on 30th March, 2012, and 7 May 2012 respectively. All responses and replies to these four motions have been received by the Appeals Chamber. The motions are under consideration by the Chamber. The second item concerns Mr. Gvero's status as an appellant in these proceedings, and I want to move to private session to discuss this.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, just for the record --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: We are still in private session?

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: No, we just moved into open session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: We are in public session.

utterances.speaker: MR. OSTOJIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. On behalf of Mr. Beara, he has no issues to raise and I understand he is in relatively good health. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Nikolic. THE APPELLANT NIKOLIC: [Interpretation] Mr. President, I am of good health and there is nothing to raise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Miletic. THE APPELLANT MILETIC: [Interpretation] Mr. President, there is nothing in particular to raise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Mr. Pandurevic. THE APPELLANT PANDUREVIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I am of good health. Other than that, there are no problems.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. May I ask counsel now whether there are any other matters that they wish to raise. Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOURGON
utterances.text: Good morning, Mr. President. There are indeed two issues we would like to raise on behalf of our client, Mr. Nikolic, both of which have to deal with the upcoming oral hearing in this case. Based on information obtained in the last President's report before the Security Council, it is our understanding that the appeals hearing in this case is likely to be scheduled before the summer recess. While we understand that the Appeals Chamber is most likely not in a position to provide us with more information regarding the exact date of the hearing, we nonetheless wish to take this opportunity to raise two issues. The first one being the notice required before the holding of the oral hearing, and the second one regarding the fact that we are likely to need the assistance of the Appeals Chamber in our dealings with OLAD. Regarding the first issue, Mr. President, due to the duration of the delay between the briefing of this appeal and the holding of the oral hearing, we anticipate that two full-time months' of work will be required for us to prepare. In other words, we ask for the indulgence of the Chamber in giving us a notice of a minimum of two months before the oral hearing can take place. With regards to the second issue, suffice it to say, at this time, Mr. President, that we have exhausted all resources which have been allocated to represent our client during this appeal. Disclosure keeps pouring in. We are working still with our client, and a lot of additional work will be required for preparation in terms of the oral hearing coming up. We just wish to place on the record at this time that we will be seizing the Registry with a request in this regard and wanted to be sure that the Appeals Chamber was aware of this fact. Thank you very much, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Mr. Bourgon, I thank you for bringing both matters to the attention of the Chamber. Any other matters?

utterances.speaker: MR. OSTOJIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. And just for the record, we would like to join on that oral request and motion on behalf of Mr. Beara.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: You're also requesting the period of two months?

utterances.speaker: MR. OSTOJIC
utterances.text: I think it's reasonable or at least a reasonable period of time. I think anywhere from six to eight weeks would be reasonable, and I would join in that request, yes, Your Honour, on both requests that was made.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: The Chamber will give it consideration.

utterances.speaker: MR. OSTOJIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Any other issues to be raised by counsel?

utterances.speaker: MR. SCHNEIDER
utterances.text: Nothing for the Prosecution. Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: The Status Conference is at an end. We are adjourned.

procedural_notes.text: [The appellants Popovic and Beara not present]
--- Whereupon the Status Conference adjourned at
